title: New Austin Manager Named Quickly
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened with the sole purpose of appointing Austin's new City Manager.
*   Mr. Norman Barker was unanimously selected by the council members present to fill the City Manager position.
*   The entire decision-making process was exceptionally swift, with the meeting concluding in just five minutes.
*   No other policy decisions, public hearings, or discussion items were on the agenda for this highly focused session.
